reviews.author: Gary Chen
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Beach Boys Auto! I worked with Donald, Michael, and Kyle, and the whole team was professional, knowledgeable, and easy to deal with from start to finish. They’re truly a one-stop shop for all your vehicle needs, whether it’s restoration work, regular maintenance, or even specialty projects. They even worked on my UTV and did an excellent job. It’s hard to find a shop that can handle so many different types of work and still deliver quality, but these guys definitely do. Highly recommend if you’re looking for reliable service and a team that knows what they’re doing!

reviews.author: Thomas Hall
reviews.text: The Beach Boys Team is awesome! Fast and top notch service. They do all of my oil changes and car maintenance needs. I recently got the best pricing on a set of wheels and tires for my Dodge Charger Scatpack Daytona 392 and their work was awesome. Every detail taken care of. Always extremely happy with their services but the best part is their great attitudes and communication. So whether you're needing a complete Classic car Restoration or full automotive servicing, routine maintenance, repairs small or big, give Donnie and Kyle a call or drop in!

reviews.author: Casey Miller
reviews.text: Always available to help with anything I need & always makes me feel like family! Plus they have some pretty cute boxer puppies to keep you entertained while you have a short wait!

reviews.author: Bruce Foerster
reviews.text: Excellent service!! I needed an electronic device installed and wired up. These guys had us in and out in no time at all. I looked at the wiring and observed a first class and neat and clean installation. Five stars and highly recommended.

reviews.author: Brice Sanders
reviews.text: These guys do it all! Dropped my truck off for a lift kit and a fresh set of tires and they communicated through the whole process and did top notch work. I’m a very picky guy to please and they exceeded expectations!

reviews.author: Patrick F
reviews.text: Beach boys is my go to for any automotive work! They did my lift on my truck did a amazing job and I’ve had 0 issues out of the install

reviews.author: rscia50
reviews.text: 5 star service and prices! Donald is the man! His son, however, is a wing nut. Still recommend these fine mechanics to everyone! By FAR The best prices and service anywhere on the beach!

reviews.author: Chris Raeker
reviews.text: Absolutely the best experience I’ve ever had an auto repair place in my life and I’m not young. Thanks for all your help Don you guys did a great job

reviews.author: Anthony L.
reviews.text: Pretty good, I was having trouble with the seatbelt for the driver seat. They managed to do some shaving and wiping of the belt and get it working better. It was a high milage car so that was half the problem. Apparently it's very hard for anyone to even find replacement seatbelts anymore with that whole issue with airbags now. Since it's all tied in together. Anyway I don't even have that car again. Might have to hit them up in the future for estimates on projects I'm planning on with my truck now.

reviews.author: Mickey Finn
reviews.text: Had them do a tire rotation and balance, Downside is they scratched all four of my 20 inch polished wheels.I wish they had used the proper socket with the extension which would have avoided this damage. They were nice guys, just bummed about this.

reviews.author: Marissa Beckley
reviews.text: I went in to see if they would help me figure out which tire was going flat, not only did he check all my tires, but he didn't charge me a cent and I use this place for oil changes regularly. Decent people, I am definitely going to go back!

reviews.author: Rich Hall
reviews.text: Fit my 35 year old classic car into his schedule to diagnose and fix my air conditioning.. Done in 24 hours and blowing cold!

reviews.author: Lee Lovelace
reviews.text: The guys at Beach Boys are knowledgeable, friendly, and actually care about your vehicle. I recommend them wholeheartedly for any mechanical needs you may have.

reviews.author: GEORGE WHETZEL
reviews.text: I have had several types of service done by Don and his father. They have always been honest and do great work at reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Glenn Pips
reviews.text: These guys treat us like family. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for honest mechanics. We are customers for life.

reviews.author: Kevin Krehmeyer
reviews.text: Awesome shop! We were on vacation and had a lower ball joint give out. Donald and his guys took care of things same day and super fast. They know their stuff! Very affordable too. I appreciate their honesty and professionalism. Highly recommended! Thanks for your help!

reviews.author: Alexis Brock
reviews.text: Great experience getting my oil changed and tires rotated. Very honest and reliable people would recommend to anyone!
